# k3d_helm_release (Resource)

A Helm release. Set exactly one of `src_path` for a local chart folder, or `chart` for a chart from a repository or `oci://` registry, which also needs `chart_version`. Every apply that changes something upgrades the release, and its values always match the configuration exactly. Changes made outside Terraform, such as a manual `helm upgrade` or `helm rollback`, show up as a new revision, and the next apply restores the configuration. Helm waits for resources before it runs `post-install` hooks, so `wait` hangs if those resources need the hook to become ready: use a regular Job or an init container. Creating a release that already exists fails: import it instead, with `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`. Private `oci://` charts use credentials from `helm registry login`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_helm_release" "podinfo" {
  cluster       = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace     = k3d_namespace.app.name
  name          = "podinfo"
  repository    = "https://stefanprodan.github.io/podinfo"
  chart         = "podinfo"
  chart_version = "6.16.0"

  values = [yamlencode({ replicaCount = 2 })]
}

resource "k3d_helm_release" "runner" {
  cluster       = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace     = "arc-systems"
  name          = "arc"
  chart         = "oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller"
  chart_version = "0.14.2"
}

resource "k3d_helm_release" "local" {
  cluster               = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace             = k3d_namespace.app.name
  name                  = "acme-web"
  src_path              = abspath("${path.module}/../acme-web/charts/acme-web")
  expected_chart_digest = var.acme_web_chart_digest
  set                   = { "image.tag" = "1.0.1" }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Release name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `atomic` (Boolean) Undo a failed install or upgrade. Defaults to `false`.
- `chart` (String) Chart name in `repository`, or a full `oci://` reference.
- `chart_version` (String) Exact chart version. Required with `chart`, so a release is reproducible.
- `cleanup_on_fail` (Boolean) Delete objects a failed upgrade created. Defaults to `false`.
- `cluster` (String) Cluster to manage the object in, usually `k3d_cluster.<name>.id`, so the object is recreated when the cluster is replaced. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `create_namespace` (Boolean) Create the namespace if it is missing. It is not removed with the release. Defaults to `false`.
- `expected_chart_digest` (String) Fail the plan unless the local chart has this `chart_digest`, which pins it to known content.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster that is reached directly and not through Docker. Not recorded as a dependency on the cluster's lifetime, so prefer `cluster` for clusters in the same configuration. It is stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.
- `max_history` (Number) Revisions to keep. Defaults to 10.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the object. Defaults to `default`.
- `plain_http` (Boolean) Use HTTP instead of HTTPS for an `oci://` registry, such as a local `k3d_registry`. Defaults to `false`.
- `repository` (String) URL of a classic chart repository. Not used with `oci://` charts.
- `set` (Map of String) Individual values, applied after every document. Keys and types follow Helm's `--set` rules, so `"3"` becomes a number.
- `src_path` (String) Path to a local chart folder on the machine running Terraform. Use `abspath("${path.module}/...")` so it does not depend on the working directory. A chart with dependencies needs `Chart.lock` and a built `charts/` folder.
- `take_ownership` (Boolean) Let the release adopt existing objects its chart defines, such as a namespace created earlier. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (String) How long an install, upgrade, or uninstall can take. Defaults to `10m`.
- `values` (List of String) YAML documents, merged in order with later ones winning.
- `values_wo` (List of String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) YAML documents that never reach Terraform plan or state, merged after `values`. Bump `values_wo_version` to apply changes. Helm still stores them in its release Secret in the cluster. Needs Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `values_wo_version` (Number) Change this to apply the current `values_wo`.
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait for the release's resources to be ready. Defaults to `true`.
- `wait_for_jobs` (Boolean) With `wait`, also wait for Jobs to complete. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `app_version` (String) App version of the chart that is deployed.
- `chart_digest` (String) Digest of a local chart, null for remote charts. Computed during plan, so an edited chart shows as a change.
- `deployed_chart_version` (String) Version of the chart that is deployed.
- `id` (String) `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`.
- `revision` (Number) Current revision of the release.
- `status` (String) Current status of the release.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_helm_release.podinfo demo/app/podinfo
```
